values.description: Base URL for the Temporal Workflow API
Current workflow ID (automatically set by Start Workflow request)
Default status filter for listing workflows. Valid values: Running, Completed, Failed, Canceled, Terminated
Query name for MyWorkflow. Must be in ALLOWED_QUERIES in src/routers/workflows.py (default: 'get_status'). Add your workflow's queries there.
Default task queue for workflow execution
3-step HITL workflow from temporal-workflow-worker-starter: my_activity, call_strands_agent, then waits for the 'approve' signal.

Signal name for the Send Signal to Workflow request. Must be in ALLOWED_SIGNALS in src/models.py: 'provide_feedback', 'provide_plan_feedback', 'cancel_workflow'. approve/approve_plan/approve_research are not allowed here - use the Approve Workflow request instead.
approver_id sent with Send Signal to Workflow and Approve Workflow requests.

comments sent with Send Signal to Workflow when signalName is provide_feedback or provide_plan_feedback (required, non-empty). Ignored when signalName is cancel_workflow - that request's pre-request script sends JSON null for comments automatically, regardless of this value, since cancel_workflow rejects any comments at all.
Internal - computed by Send Signal to Workflow's pre-request script from signalName and signalComments. Do not set manually.
content_digest sent with Approve Workflow. Must match the digest of the content currently under review for the selected lane.
lane sent with Approve Workflow: 'general' (default), 'plan', or 'research'.
Bearer token for /workflows/* requests. Set to the API's API_AUTH_TOKEN; requests are rejected (401) when it is missing or wrong.
Current run ID (automatically set by Start Workflow; used by Approve Workflow)
